findings.title: Historical cluster-1: Output-trigger resend used append-mode Continue
findings.expected: A trigger-requested resend must be a plain send without a say-nothing prefix.
findings.actual: The resend entered append-mode Continue and baked a boundary into transcript and payload.
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-2: Legacy monolithic preset imports dropped the model half
findings.expected: Legacy model-bearing preset imports must give the user a model-half import choice.
findings.actual: The prompt half imported while provider/model and sampler intent were silently lost.
findings.userConsequence: Legacy monolithic preset imports dropped the model half
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-4: Continue ignored non-empty composer text
findings.expected: Continue with typed text must run input processing, append and consume the user row, then continue.
findings.actual: The typed text was neither sent nor consumed.
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-5: Kobold path-bearing endpoints were rewritten
findings.expected: Legacy Kobold paths longer than the baseline root threshold must be posted verbatim.
findings.actual: Segment overlap joining changed user-supplied paths.
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-6: Interrupted-send retry could transform the user turn twice
findings.expected: Retry must key idempotency to the accepted message and not rerun committed input transforms.
findings.actual: Retry compared only ID and role, allowing append/transforms to repeat.
findings.userConsequence: Interrupted-send retry could transform the user turn twice
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-7: Stop ownership leaked across operations and shutdown lost partials
findings.expected: Stop controls must bind to the active operation and shutdown must preserve replayable cancellation finalization.
findings.actual: Settled stop state could hide later controls and shutdown force-terminalized stopping work.
findings.userConsequence: Stop ownership leaked across operations and shutdown lost partials
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-8: Durable effect and memory-job ownership gaps
findings.expected: Lua description writes, claimed effects, terminal patches, and memory cancellation must have durable isolated ownership.
findings.actual: Description writes were absent, claims could strand, patches omitted owners, and a batch shared one abort controller.
findings.userConsequence: Durable effect and memory-job ownership gaps
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-9: Half-streaming Stop diverged display from persistence
findings.expected: A stopped partial must reconcile the displayed and durable row.
findings.actual: The display removed an empty local row while the server retained a partial.
findings.userConsequence: Half-streaming Stop diverged display from persistence
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-10: Replay gaps could lose or duplicate visible continuation text
findings.expected: Canonical terminal text must remain consumable after replay eviction without duplicate partial continuation.
findings.actual: Replay caps could evict necessary context and reattach could duplicate the partial.
findings.userConsequence: Replay gaps could lose or duplicate visible continuation text
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-15: Whole-array lore conflict fencing dropped unrelated script changes
findings.expected: Concurrent local-lore changes must merge per entry while retaining per-key conflict safety.
findings.actual: Any unrelated lore edit could drop the entire scripted lore result.
findings.userConsequence: Whole-array lore conflict fencing dropped unrelated script changes
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-16: A normal same-chat send could invalidate queued finalization
findings.expected: Same-chat admission must fence a replayable finalization.
findings.actual: Finalizing was excluded from the live-operation fence, allowing a second send to destroy the provisional result.
findings.userConsequence: A normal same-chat send could invalidate queued finalization
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-17: Fail-closed CharX imports discarded salvageable content
findings.expected: Imports must salvage supported entries and visibly report dropped oversized content.
findings.actual: One oversized optional entry or data URI rejected the whole card.
findings.userConsequence: Fail-closed CharX imports discarded salvageable content
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-18: Standalone CHAT blocks rejected otherwise supported saves
findings.expected: Imports must salvage supported blocks and report an unsupported CHAT block.
findings.userConsequence: Standalone CHAT blocks rejected otherwise supported saves
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Historical cluster-21: Agent-only lore exported as active Original-compatible lore
findings.expected: Agent-only entries must be neutralized on cross-app export.
findings.actual: Export preserved activation configuration that Original could execute.
findings.userConsequence: Agent-only lore exported as active Original-compatible lore
findings.residualRisk: Historical resolution imported; the owning domain phase must re-run current regression evidence.

findings.title: Lossy compatibility normalization hid unintended persisted generation metadata
findings.expected: When prompt metadata persistence is disabled and no Agent Preset is active, generated transcript rows match the baseline empty promptInfo shape and omit Agent Preset diagnostics; prompt preview still exposes authoritative token diagnostics.
findings.actual: The prior normalizer discarded arbitrary transcript metadata, hiding persisted prompt token fields and an inactive Agent Preset status block; the first correction also erased prompt-preview token diagnostics until the preview and persistence contracts were separated.
findings.userConsequence: Reloaded chats carried unintended metadata and the compatibility golden could not detect it; an intermediate correction also made prompt preview token counts unavailable.
reproduction: test/compat-harness/normalize.test.ts preserves arbitrary transcript metadata and missing/null distinctions
server/fastify/__tests__/assemble.test.ts verifies inactive Agent Preset omission and disabled promptInfo persistence
server/fastify/__tests__/generation.chat.test.ts verifies preview token diagnostics remain available
findings.residualRisk: Prompt preview and transcript persistence share assembly data but now have separate regression assertions; later prompt metadata additions remain governed by the lossless differential.
